---
description: "Forms text, number, choice, and range editors with their renderers"
---

- Forms editors and selectors group overview:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Api-Editors.h`
- Edit single-line text, selection, cursor position, validation, and input methods:
  `include/Pt/Forms/LineEdit.h`
- Use the low-level editable-line text model and operations:
  `include/Pt/Forms/LineEditor.h`
- Edit numeric values with increment and decrement controls:
  `include/Pt/Forms/SpinBox.h`
- Select or enter values from a drop-down list:
  `include/Pt/Forms/ComboBox.h`
- Select values from a continuous or discrete range:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Slider.h`
- Customize line-edit visual state, measurement, layout, and rendering:
  `include/Pt/Forms/LineEditStyler.h`
- Customize spin-box visual state, measurement, layout, and rendering:
  `include/Pt/Forms/SpinBoxStyler.h`
- Customize combo-box visual state, measurement, layout, and rendering:
  `include/Pt/Forms/ComboBoxStyler.h`
- Customize slider visual state, measurement, layout, and rendering:
  `include/Pt/Forms/SliderStyler.h`
